    Home / Docs / Models

    Models

    List the models a key may use, with their prices, and read the public catalogue without a key.

    Use this page to see which models your key can route to and what they cost. You can also read the public catalogue without a key.

    List the models your key can use

    GET /v1/models lists what this key may route to, in the OpenAI list shape.

    curl
    curl https://api.massrelay.ai/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_KEY"

    Each entry carries a massrelay object with these fields:

    • provider — the provider that serves the model.
    • custody — whose key pays the provider for this route (see Bring your own key).
    • family — the model family.
    • prices — per million tokens, where a rate is known.
    • reasoning options — where the catalogue states them.

    A model the workspace brought itself says ownedBy: workspace. Aliases are listed after the models and are marked alias; an alias is a name that routes, never a real model.

    Note The listing is served for keys on the L1 routing layer. Other key layers get a 501 not_ported answer rather than a guess.

    Read the public catalogue

    GET /public/models and GET /public/models/{provider}/{model} need no credential. They show the catalogue with the price per million input and output tokens and, on the detail page, latency and uptime. A figure backed by too few calls is null, never a small number. Partner models appear with partner: true.

    curl
    curl https://api.massrelay.ai/public/models

    A catalogue generated from the provider feeds is not available yet; today the catalogue is the one the router ships.

    API reference

    GET /v1/models

    Authentication relay key (bearer)

    Example request

    curl
    curl https://api.massrelay.ai/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELAY_KEY"
    Python
    import os, requests

r = requests.get(
    "https://api.massrelay.ai/v1/models",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['RELAY_KEY']}"},
)
r.raise_for_status()
print(r.json())
    TypeScript
    const r = await fetch("https://api.massrelay.ai/v1/models", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.RELAY_KEY}` },
});
if (!r.ok) throw new Error(`${r.status} ${await r.text()}`);
console.log(await r.json());

    Response

    FieldTypeDescription
    object requiredstringThe kind of object returned, for example chat.completion. Always "list".
    data requiredarray of objectThe list of items returned.
    data[].id requiredstringA model id, or an alias name (after the models).
    data[].object requiredstringThe kind of object returned, for example chat.completion. Always "model".
    data[].massrelayobject
    data[].massrelay.providerstring
    data[].massrelay.custodystring
    data[].massrelay.familystring
    data[].massrelay.reasoning_optionsobject
    data[].massrelay.price_bandsarray
    data[].massrelay.ownedBystringPresent only for the workspace's own model. Always "workspace".
    data[].massrelay.inputUsdPerMnumber
    data[].massrelay.outputUsdPerMnumber
    data[].massrelay.aliasbooleanPresent on an alias entry. Always true.
    data[].massrelay.startTierobject
    data[].massrelay.preferOwnModelsboolean
    Example response (shape)
    {
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "<id>",
      "object": "model",
      "massrelay": {
        "provider": "<provider>",
        "custody": "<custody>",
        "family": "<family>",
        "reasoning_options": "<reasoning_options>",
        "price_bands": [],
        "ownedBy": "workspace",
        "inputUsdPerM": 0,
        "outputUsdPerM": 0,
        "alias": true,
        "startTier": "<startTier>",
        "preferOwnModels": false
      }
    }
  ]
}

    Common errors

    • 401 invalid_api_key
    • 403 insufficient_scope
    • 429 over the request rate; read Retry-After

    Every error has the same JSON shape; see Errors and Limits.

    Full schema (JSON)

    Response schema

    {
  "description": "Served for an L1 key; any other key layer answers 501 not_ported. The massrelay keys listed are those the handler inserts; a key appears only when its source row exists.",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "object",
    "data"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object": {
      "const": "list"
    },
    "data": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "object"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "A model id, or an alias name (after the models)."
          },
          "object": {
            "const": "model"
          },
          "massrelay": {
            "type": "object",
            "additionalProperties": true,
            "properties": {
              "provider": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "custody": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "family": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "reasoning_options": {},
              "price_bands": {
                "type": "array"
              },
              "ownedBy": {
                "const": "workspace",
                "description": "Present only for the workspace's own model."
              },
              "inputUsdPerM": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "outputUsdPerM": {
                "type": "number"
              },
              "alias": {
                "const": true,
                "description": "Present on an alias entry."
              },
              "startTier": {},
              "preferOwnModels": {
                "type": "boolean"
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

    GET /public/models

    Authentication public, no credential

    Response

    FieldTypeDescription
    floor requiredinteger
    models requiredarray of object
    models[].provider requiredstring
    models[].model requiredstringThe model id. In a request it is optional: without it the key's routing chooses.
    models[].familystring or null
    models[].contextWindowinteger or null
    models[].priceInputPerMillionUsdnumber or null
    models[].priceOutputPerMillionUsdnumber or null
    models[].partner requiredboolean
    Example response (shape)
    {
  "floor": 0,
  "models": [
    {
      "provider": "<provider>",
      "model": "provider/model-id",
      "family": "<family>",
      "contextWindow": "<contextWindow>",
      "priceInputPerMillionUsd": "<priceInputPerMillionUsd>",
      "priceOutputPerMillionUsd": "<priceOutputPerMillionUsd>",
      "partner": false
    }
  ]
}

    GET /public/models/{provider}/{model}

    Authentication public, no credential

    Path parameters

    provider requiredstring
    model requiredstring

    Response

    FieldTypeDescription
    provider requiredstring
    model requiredstringThe model id. In a request it is optional: without it the key's routing chooses.
    familystring or null
    contextWindowinteger or null
    priceInputPerMillionUsdnumber or null
    priceOutputPerMillionUsdnumber or null
    partner requiredboolean
    latencyobject
    latency.p50Msnumber or null
    latency.p95Msnumber or null
    latency.windowstring Always "24h".
    uptimeobject
    uptime.5mnull
    uptime.30mnull
    uptime.1dnumber or null
    floorinteger
    Example response (shape)
    {
  "provider": "<provider>",
  "model": "provider/model-id",
  "family": "<family>",

  "priceInputPerMillionUsd": "<priceInputPerMillionUsd>",
